title: Can I use my Indian driving licence?
shortAnswer: Depends on residency and current Latvian regulations.
answer: Foreign driving licences may be accepted only under certain conditions. Students staying long term may eventually need a Latvian or recognised licence. Always verify the latest requirements before driving.

title: Do I need to validate my bus ticket?
shortAnswer: Always follow the transport operator's ticket validation rules.
answer: Depending on the ticket type, validation may be required before or immediately after boarding. Follow the official transport operator's instructions.
tips: Keep it until your journey ends.

title: Can international students work?
shortAnswer: Check the conditions attached to your residence permit and applicable regulations.
answer: Work permissions depend on your immigration status and applicable Latvian regulations. Review the current requirements before accepting employment.
tips: Understand employment conditions before starting work.
